panel.introduction: 103P/Hartley 2 is the elongated, two-lobed comet visited by EPOXI in 2010. Gray marks stereo control, blue limb silhouettes, and ochre poorly constrained regions of the published shape.

facts.label: Stereo coverage
facts.value: 244 stereo control points on about half the nucleus

moreFacts.label: Presentation
moreFacts.value: Published PDS shape model, including poorly constrained source estimates. The constraint lens uses gray for stereo control, blue for limb silhouettes, and ochre for poorly constrained terrain. These are evidence categories, not surface colors. The cartographic north direction follows the long axis at the 2010 encounter, not a spin pole. Hartley 2 tumbles; this display holds an arbitrary rotational phase and does not simulate that motion.
